notes: Fixes the echo. FleetComm was re-routing its audio output on every microphone open, even when you hadn't chosen a device — and re-routing after the mic is live leaves the browser's echo canceller without a reference, so the room comes back down the net. It now only switches output when you actually pick a device. There is also a transmit gate: below a set level nothing is sent, so speaker bleed stops riding out under everyone else's voice. It opens on the first frame of speech and holds through dips, so nothing is clipped. If your microphone reports no echo cancellation at all, Settings now says so. Also in this build: sign-in requires fleet Discord membership, tuning a net you can't access says so instead of connecting you to nothing, quieter shipwide soundboard that no longer needs TX ALL, overlay controls beside AUTHENTICATED, and denser channel rows with deeper nest indentation.
